# Third-party files

Copies of the libraries and the typeface the pages use, served by the app so
that a visitor's browser contacts no other server. The version is in each file
name; to update one, download the new file, change the name here and in the
view that loads it.

| File | What | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bootstrap-5.3.3.min.css`, `bootstrap-5.3.3.bundle.min.js` | Bootstrap | `cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/` | MIT |
| `d3-7.9.0.min.js` | D3 | `cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/` | ISC |
| `d3-flextree-2.1.2.min.js` | d3-flextree | `cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3-flextree@2.1.2/build/` | WTFPL |
| `d3-org-chart-3.1.1.min.js` | d3-org-chart | `cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3-org-chart@3.1.1/build/` | MIT |
| `fonts/outfit-latin.woff2`, `fonts/outfit-latin-ext.woff2` | Outfit (variable, v15) | Google Fonts | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
